items.q: this is where Lady Day worked with us. Oh yeah, oh yeah -- she worked there for several weeks.

ctx.x: That's right, and this is where Lady Day worked with us. Oh yeah, oh yeah -- she worked there for several weeks. Billy Holiday. But at this time, Jimmy Rowles was playing piano with me then. Okay. So when Jimmy Rowles first came to town, he worked with Lee Lester Young's band, and Bumps and Red and Louis Gonzales.

So we worked at the Trouville for awhile, and -- that was a real good job. We didn't go to work until 10 o'clock at night. We played at 10, and we -- you know, off at 10:30 and go back at 11, you know, go back on at 12, go back on at 1, and stay until 1:30, and that was the end of our gig.
